title: Thomason Model Structures in Every Strict Higher Dimension

issues.location: Sec. 2 (eq. steiner-tensor) and Lemma 3.1 (compatibility with degeneracies)
issues.description: The prism construction needs the Steiner–Gray comparison ν K ⊗ ν L ≅ ν(K⊗L) to be natural for every ADC morphism between strong Steiner complexes, including maps that send basis elements to zero (degeneracies). The paper does not prove this; it takes it from Ara–Maltsiniotis 2020, Thm A.15. The result is standard, but the whole cylinder construction rests on this external input.
issues.evidence: 'Naturality here is for every morphism between strong Steiner complexes, including maps sending basis elements to sums or zero. This is the completed extension theorem'

coverage: Read Sections 1–7 in full; skimmed the presentability appendix and did not audit it. Checked the relative-prism chain identity dh(w) = C(d(x⊗u)) by hand and with a randomized script over 3000 random posets, sieves and admissible pairs f ≤ g: 0 failures. Hand-checked: the T_σ total-order argument; stationarity on the old sieve A (C_σ = F∘(id⊗ε)); the gluing of stationary cylinders through the internal hom H(Y) in nCat; monotonicity of k and g and the zigzag id ≤ g ≥ k = jp in Lemma 5.1; the induction that deletes maximal elements, with full-sieve covers after an arbitrary attachment (Prop 4.4 and Cor 4.5); the filtered colimit over finite q-stable subsets; the attachment comparison (couniversality on the upward closure Z, then a cosieve cover, then left properness); the identification of the Sd² boundary and horn posets and the retraction r(σ) = σ∩P_K; the small object argument; both properness proofs; the subdivided-unit induction; and the Quillen-equivalence criterion.
main_claim: For every 1 ≤ n ≤ ∞, nCat has a proper combinatorial model structure transferred along c_n Sd² ⊣ Ex² N_n, generated by (L_n I, L_n J) and Quillen equivalent to sSet_KQ. This proves the Ara–Maltsiniotis conjecture. The key step: pushouts of U(A) → U(E), for A a sieve whose inclusion has a right adjoint retraction, are Street weak equivalences. This uses Gray cylinders that are constant on U(A).
